panels.title: Slowest traces (top 20)
panels.description: Top 20 request_trace events by total_duration_ms (unfiltered -- pick a trace_id here, then edit the query bar in Trace detail table/Trace phase totals to drill into it). STALE SIGNAL, same request_trace family (794 requests, 2026-04-23 to 2026-06-07, silent 24+ days). FINDING: distribution is extremely right-skewed -- top traces run 4.7-18.8 minutes (1,128,878ms / 1,095,568ms / 921,288ms for the top 3), far above the ~29.8s average established in the sibling Request Timing dashboard. Cross-checked directly against ES: the top 3 slow traces (f5684891, 7941bb73, 44a2c00a) have 43/29/25 total_steps vs. ~11 steps for a typical trace, suggesting these are requests with unusually long tool-execution/retry sequences rather than measurement artifacts. An average-only view (like Total duration over time) hides this tail entirely.

panels.title: Trace phase totals
panels.description: Step count and total duration per phase, for the same example trace as the Trace detail table panel (trace_id 763278fa-fbac-444b-b689-b79933158909). llm_inference is 2 of 11 steps but 8.5s of the 19.3s total (44%) -- the dominant cost for this specific request. STALE SIGNAL: request_trace_step stopped emitting on 2026-06-07, 24+ days before this build, with no replacement found.

panels.title: Trace detail table
panels.description: Step-by-step breakdown (sequence, phase, step name, duration, offset) for one example trace (trace_id 763278fa-fbac-444b-b689-b79933158909, 11 steps, total 19.3s). To trace a DIFFERENT request, edit the trace_id in this panel's query bar to any other value from the Slowest traces panel. STALE SIGNAL: request_trace_step (9834 docs, 2026-04-23 to 2026-06-07) stopped emitting on 2026-06-07, 24+ days before this build, with no replacement found -- this shows what end-to-end tracing looked like while the instrumentation was live, not a currently-updating tool.
